/**
 * [XMLBEANS-66]   NullPointerException when restricting a union with one of the union members
 */
@Test
void test_jira_XmlBeans66() throws Exception {
    String reproXsd = "<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> 
" + "<xsd:schema targetNamespace="http://www.w3.org/2003/12/XQueryX" 
" + "      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2003/12/XQueryX" 
" + "      xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" 
" + "      elementFormDefault="qualified" 
" + "      attributeFormDefault="qualified"> 
" + "  <!-- Kludge for anySimpleType --> 
" + "  <xsd:simpleType name="constantValueType"> 
" + "    <xsd:union memberTypes="xsd:integer xsd:decimal xsd:string xsd:double"/> 
" + "  </xsd:simpleType> 
" + "  <!-- constant expressions. We have 4 different subclasses for this --> 
" + "  <xsd:complexType name="constantExpr"> 
" + "        <xsd:sequence> 
" + "          <xsd:element name="value" type="constantValueType"/> 
" + "        </xsd:sequence> 
" + "  </xsd:complexType> 
" + "  <xsd:complexType name="integerConstantExpr"> 
" + "    <xsd:complexContent> 
" + "      <xsd:restriction base="constantExpr"> 
" + "        <xsd:sequence> 
" + "          <xsd:element name="value" type="xsd:integer"/> 
" + "        </xsd:sequence> 
" + "      </xsd:restriction> 
" + "    </xsd:complexContent> 
" + "  </xsd:complexType>" + "<!-- added for element validation -->" + "<xsd:element name="Kludge" type="integerConstantExpr" />
" + "</xsd:schema> ";
    SchemaTypeLoader stl = makeSchemaTypeLoader(new String[] { reproXsd });
    QName reproQName = new QName("http://www.w3.org/2003/12/XQueryX", "Kludge");
    SchemaGlobalElement elVal = stl.findElement(reproQName);
    assertTrue((elVal != null), "Element is null or not found");
    String reproInst = "<Kludge xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2003/12/XQueryX"><value>12</value></Kludge>";
    validateInstance(new String[] { reproXsd }, new String[] { reproInst }, null);
}

@Test
void testAttributeError() throws XmlException {
    String empSchema = "<xs:schema xmlns:xs='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema'   elementFormDefault='qualified'>
" + "<xs:element name='age'>
" + "<xs:simpleType>
" + "<xs:restriction base='xs:integer'>
" + "<xs:minInclusive value='0'/>
" + "<xs:maxInclusive value='100'/>
" + "</xs:restriction>
" + "</xs:simpleType>
" + "</xs:element>
" + "<xs:element name='empRecords'>
" + "<xs:complexType>
" + "<xs:sequence>
" + "<xs:element name='person' type='personType' maxOccurs='unbounded'/>
" + "</xs:sequence>
" + "</xs:complexType>
" + "</xs:element>
" + "<xs:element name='name' type='xs:string'/>
" + "<xs:complexType name='personType'>
" + "<xs:sequence>
" + "<xs:element ref='name'/>
" + "<xs:element ref='age'/>
" + "</xs:sequence>
" + "<xs:attribute name='employee' use='required'>
" + "<xs:simpleType>
" + "<xs:restriction base='xs:NMTOKEN'>
" + "<xs:enumeration value='current'/>
" + "<xs:enumeration value='past'/>
" + "</xs:restriction>
" + "</xs:simpleType>
" + "</xs:attribute>
" + "</xs:complexType>
" + "</xs:schema>
";
    String[] schemas = { empSchema };
    String xmlInstance = "<empRecords xmlns:xsi='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' >" + "<person employee='past'>" + "<name>joe blow</name>" + "<age>31</age>" + "</person>" + "<person>" + "<name>test user</name>" + "<age>29</age>" + "</person>" + "</empRecords>";
    List<XmlError> errors = performValidation(schemas, xmlInstance);
    assertNotNull(errors);
    assertFalse(errors.isEmpty());
    for (XmlError error : errors) {
        assertEquals(error.getMessage(), "Expected attribute: employee in element person");
        // todo check XmlValidationError
    }
}

@Test
void testValidateNestedGroups() throws Exception {
    // This is a weird Schema, inspired from JIRA bug XMLBEANS-35
    // Make sure we compile it and then validate correctly
    String[] schemas = { "<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" targetNamespace="http://tempuri.org/f_up_groups" xmlns:tns="http://tempuri.org/f_up_groups">
" + "
" + "<xs:group name="d">
" + "	<xs:sequence>
" + "	    <xs:element name="error">
" + "	    	<xs:complexType>
" + "	    		<xs:group ref="tns:e"/>
" + "	    	</xs:complexType>
" + "	    </xs:element>
" + "	</xs:sequence>
" + "</xs:group>
" + "
" + "<xs:group name="e">
" + "	<xs:sequence>
" + "		<xs:element name="error" minOccurs="0">
" + "			<xs:complexType>
" + "				<xs:group ref="tns:d"/>
" + "			</xs:complexType>
" + "		</xs:element>
" + "	</xs:sequence>
" + "</xs:group>
" + "
" + "<xs:element name="root">
" + "	<xs:complexType>
" + " 	<xs:group ref="tns:d"/>
" + "	</xs:complexType>
" + "</xs:element>
" + "
" + "</xs:schema>
" };
    String[] valid = { "<ns:root xmlns:ns="http://tempuri.org/f_up_groups">
" + "   <error>
" + "      <error>
" + "         <error/>" + "      </error>
" + "    </error>
" + "</ns:root>
" };
    String[] invalid = { "<ns:root xmlns:ns="http://tempuri.org/f_up_groups">
" + "   <error>
" + "      <error>
" + "      </error>
" + "    </error>
" + "</ns:root>
" };
    doTest(schemas, null, valid, invalid);
}

@Test
void testEnumRestriction() throws Exception {
    String schema = "<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
" + "    xmlns:tns="foo" targetNamespace="foo">
" + "
" + "    <xs:simpleType name="parent">
" + "        <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
" + "            <xs:enumeration value="abc"/>
" + "            <xs:enumeration value="123"/>
" + "        </xs:restriction>
" + "    </xs:simpleType>
" + "
" + "    <xs:simpleType name="child">
" + "        <xs:restriction base="tns:parent">
" + "            <xs:enumeration value="abc"/>
" + "            <xs:enumeration value="123"/>
" + // 'xyz' is an invalid enumeration value
    "            <xs:enumeration value="xyz"/>
" + "        </xs:restriction>
" + "    </xs:simpleType>
" + "
" + "</xs:schema>
";
    XmlObject xobj = XmlObject.Factory.parse(schema);
    assertThrows(XmlException.class, () -> XmlBeans.loadXsd(xobj));
}
